deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Develop your mana, build a board of planeswalkers, and use removal and supporting creatures to keep your position stable. The Way enchantments and alternate versions of familiar characters give the deck a broader Reality Fracture identity. Its closing threats are chief among them Jace, Reality Sculptor, backed by Fblthp, Impossibly Lost, Sanctum Lurker, and several creature finishers. The deck favors a slower, board-focused game over explosive openings, and its four-color mana needs careful sequencing. For three buy-list priorities, start with Jace, Reality Sculptor, Chandra, Chill of Compliance, and Identity Echo.

The quality model grades this deck below the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
